title: Provider registry and privacy routing

subtasks.description: Add versioned model/prompt/capability manifests with language, task, license, endpoint, region and structured-output support.
subtasks.progress_note: Versioned model/prompt/capability manifests (ADR 0026): stage, provider, model and pinned revision, languages, licence policy, endpoint kind/region, structured-output support; qualified manifests refuse moving aliases (latest, main, …); the operator preflight (python -m backend.jobs.model_preflight) fails a stage without a qualified manifest; every stage run records manifest id/version/digest. Verified locally (SQLite and PostgreSQL 16); see product `docs/handoff/session-a/README.md`. Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

subtasks.description: Define per-tenant stage policies and immutable policy snapshots on each run.
subtasks.progress_note: Per-workspace, per-stage AI policies (ADR 0027): homayar.ai-policy/1 documents (endpoint kinds, regions, manifests, fallback, cloud text redacted/original), default in-process/private only, versions append-only (owner-only ai_policy:manage, optimistic concurrency, audited), and an immutable run_policy_snapshots row per processing attempt; both tables FORCE RLS and homayar_app has no UPDATE/DELETE. Migration d2b6f8a4c1e7 round-tripped on PostgreSQL 16. Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

subtasks.description: Implement privacy/eligibility filtering before health, quality, latency and cost selection.
subtasks.progress_note: Privacy/eligibility filtering before ranking, enforced at each stage boundary (ADR 0028): stage_disabled → provider → region → model → licence → language; refused ASR fails permanently, refused diarization/analysis is unavailable (partial); a cloud endpoint receives redacted text unless the policy says original; a stricter policy mid-run stops the attempt (policy_changed). Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

subtasks.description: Qualify chosen local and API adapters through identical typed contract tests, including schema rejection and usage reporting.
subtasks.progress_note: Identical typed contract tests for every adapter that exists, with schema rejection and reported-or-absent token usage (ADR 0029, migration e3a7c5f9b2d4). The Padyar AI Gateway adapter is an explicit provider_contract_unavailable boundary: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL until its API contract (endpoints, auth, models, STT/embedding support) is supplied. Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

subtasks.description: Add deadlines, rate limits, backoff, Retry-After, health circuits and approved same-policy fallback.
subtasks.progress_note: Deadline-bounded provider calls, jittered back-off, Retry-After, shared per-endpoint circuits and request windows (provider_health, migration f5b1d7c3a9e2) and approved same-policy analysis fallback recorded as fallback_used (ADR 0030); F22's injected timeout/429/5xx/invalid-schema/auth failures covered by test_provider_resilience.py. Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

subtasks.description: Block unauthorized egress at network and application layers; test local failure with cloud keys configured.
subtasks.progress_note: Application layer validated (ADR 0031): a per-call egress permit for the approved endpoint only, an endpoint (SSRF) policy refusing metadata/link-local/private-as-cloud addresses, and the preflight's egress allowlist; F21 verified through the real provider factory (local endpoint down, cloud keys present: zero cloud requests unless the owner allows cloud and fallback). Network layer pending deployment integration: internal Compose network for api/workers and an allowlisting egress proxy. Integrated product commit c5bf752c26fc2a781b72bda1506a0a709d7236f9.

dependency_note: WP08 depends on WP07. T01/T02 are independent of WP07 behaviour and may proceed once the WP07 foundations are in place; T03 requires WP07-T05/T06 (text privacy) and stays blocked until validated. WP08 is PARTIAL (2026-09-25): T01–T05 validated in local scope and T06's application layer validated (ADR 0026–ADR 0031); remaining: network-layer egress denial (deployment integration), the Padyar AI Gateway adapter (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: API contract), qualification of real models (pinned weights and representative evaluation data, WP13) and provider credentials.
